fi-toxotes-blythii.title: Clouded Archerfish
fi-toxotes-blythii.summary: A rarely seen archerfish from Myanmar with irregular dark blotches and a metallic sheen. Unlike most archerfish it lives in fresh water, and it shoots water at insects like its relatives.
rows: Keep in a group (OATA advises at least six archerfish together)
Surface insect hunter that knocks prey down with jets of water
Fresh water: it is restricted to rivers and fresh estuary reaches
Myanmar: rivers from the lower Irrawaddy to the Tanintharyi Region, including the Sittaung and Salween
notes: Once lumped with the smallscale archerfish (T. microlepis); it was split off on body shape and markings.
